ai.files.heading: All files
ai.files.download.label: Download {file}
ai.files.source: Each SHA-256 here comes from 6529 AI's signed release list, and this page checks that signature before it lists a file. The publisher is the name your system should show for the file's code signature when you open it. This page doesn't check it, so check it yourself.
ai.files.check.heading: Check a file
ai.files.check.body: Download {sums} into the folder with your download, and run the command for your system there. On a Mac or Linux it must print your file's name and OK. On Windows the two SHA-256 values must be the same; Windows prints capital letters. If they differ, delete the file.
ai.files.sig.heading: Check SHA256SUMS
ai.files.sig.body: {sig} is 6529 AI's Ed25519 signature of {sums}, made with the release key below. With OpenSSL 3, save the key as {keyFile} and run this in the folder with all three files:
ai.files.sig.result: It must print {ok}. In the 6529 AI source, {verify} checks the signature and then every file that SHA256SUMS lists.
